name: Druid Scorpion Whisperer
body:
Scorpion whisperers develop their ability to withstand poison far more quickly than typical druids.

A scorpion whisperer has the following class features.

Inured To Extremes (Ex)

At 1st level, a scorpion whisperer is constantly treated as though under the effects of endure elements.

This replaces wild empathy.

Resist Toxins (Ex)

At 2nd level, a scorpion whisperer gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison and Resist acid 5. At 4th level, the bonus on poison saving throws increases to +4 and the acid resistance increases to 10.

This replaces woodland stride and resist nature’s lure.

Digestive Enzymes (Ex)

At 15th level, as a standard action, a scorpion whisperer can spew digestive enzymes into an adjacent square. Creatures in the square must make a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your druid level + your Wisdom modifier). A creature takes 3 points of acid damage per druid level on a failed save, or half as much on a successful save.

Furthermore, a creature that failed to make its saving throw takes the same amount of acid damage again at the start of the following round. A scorpion whisperer can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1 + their Constitution modifier (minimum 1). This replaces timeless body.
